title: The Broken Provision
premise: Sebastian Dravenmoor, a disgraced railroad engineer hiding from creditors, is drawn into the tide-revealed cave of legend by a debt collector's ultimatum and a dying stranger's plea. The cave's map of closed rail lines leads them upriver toward a forbidden source that powers the region's railways—and the fortune of the family that disowned Sebastian's late mother. Pursued by the heir who wants the source sealed forever, Sebastian must choose between reclaiming their inheritance and protecting the ragtag crew who became their family, ultimately destroying the source to free the valley, at the cost of the fortune but not the found family.
about_author: Ivo Ravensworth is the pen name of a former surveyor who spent a decade mapping forgotten rail corridors across coastal valleys before turning to fiction. Their novels blend industrial history with folklore, always following characters who inherit more trouble than treasure.

chapters.title: The Tide Keeps No Ledger
chapters.summary: Sebastian Dravenmoor, evading debt collectors in a fishing village, watches the tide pull back far enough to expose a sea cave locals refuse to name. Inside, they find a dead man clutching a compass and a map marked with closed rail lines—lines Sebastian helped design. POV: Sebastian. Emotional beat: wary curiosity curdling into dread as recognition sets in.

chapters.title: A Debt Written in Water
chapters.summary: The debt collector, Marlowe Vane, arrives with an ultimatum: pay in nine days or lose everything. But Vane knows about the map and offers to forgive the debt if Sebastian retrieves what the dead man sought—the river's source. Sebastian refuses, then finds their boarding house ransacked. POV: Sebastian. Emotional beat: cornered desperation hardening into reluctant resolve.

chapters.title: The Crew Nobody Wanted
chapters.summary: Sebastian assembles an unlikely expedition: Odile, a lockkeeper's daughter who knows the river; Bramble, a disgraced tunnel foreman; and Pip, a stowaway orphan who steals the compass twice. They launch upstream past the last working lock. POV: alternating Sebastian and Odile. Emotional beat: prickly strangers beginning to function as a crew.

chapters.title: Closed Lines
chapters.summary: Following the map through abandoned tunnels, the crew discovers the closed lines weren't failures—they were deliberately sealed, each one feeding something upstream. Bramble recognizes his old foreman's seal on the last gate. Vane's hired men shadow them through the dark. POV: Bramble. Emotional beat: guilt over complicity he never understood until now.

chapters.title: What the Heir Wants Buried
chapters.summary: At a drowned station, the crew meets Cassian Dravenmoor—Sebastian's uncle and heir to the family fortune—who claims he wants to help. Odile doesn't trust him; Sebastian, starved for family, nearly does. That night Cassian's men try to burn the map. POV: Odile. Emotional beat: the ache of belonging versus the discipline of suspicion.

chapters.title: The River Remembers
chapters.summary: Ambushed at a gorge crossing, the crew loses their boat and half their supplies. Pip confesses she was sent by villagers downstream whose wells are failing—the river is being drained from its source. Sebastian realizes the inheritance isn't money; it's responsibility. POV: Pip. Emotional beat: fear of abandonment transformed into fierce loyalty.

chapters.title: Nine Days, Spent
chapters.summary: Vane catches up and reveals the truth: the dead man was Sebastian's mother's ally, and the 'debt' was bait to bring Sebastian here. Vane gives Sebastian one honest hour to decide before his employers arrive. Sebastian chooses the crew over the bargain. POV: Sebastian. Emotional beat: betrayal transmuted into clarity about who deserves trust.

chapters.title: The Forbidden Source
chapters.summary: The crew reaches the source: a vast geothermal spring beneath the mountain that powers every sealed line—and that Cassian has been throttling to manufacture scarcity and control the valley. Confrontation in the flooded cavern; Bramble holds the gate while Odile and Sebastian reach the mechanism. POV: Sebastian. Emotional beat: terror and awe in equal measure.

chapters.title: Break the Inheritance
chapters.summary: Cassian offers Sebastian everything—the name, the estate, the fortune—if they'll help him keep the source chained. Sebastian opens the floodgates instead, letting the river run free and destroying the machinery of control. Cassian is swept into his own vault of hoarded water. POV: Odile watching Sebastian choose. Emotional beat: triumphant grief for the family that never was.

chapters.title: Downstream
chapters.summary: The crew rides the freed river home, where wells refill and the village greets Pip as a hero. Vane tears up the debt, paid in full by a story instead of coin. Sebastian keeps only the compass—not as inheritance, but as a promise to keep moving with people worth moving with. POV: Sebastian. Emotional beat: quiet, earned belonging.
